identity: Red-green Domain beatdown built on one interaction: enlist taps Radha, Coalition Warlord, and her trigger reads 'Whenever Radha becomes tapped, another target creature you control gets +X/+X.' Because enlist taps her, she pays TWICE - her 3 power transfers to the attacker AND the trigger fires, and it may target that same attacker, since 'another' only excludes Radha herself. At Domain 4 a Coalition Warbrute attacks as a 10/8 trampler. The manabase is therefore the payoff: seven common typed duals (Land - Swamp Forest, Land - Island Mountain, and so on) each pay two basic land types on one card, so Domain 5 is reachable without spending a single rare slot. Radha also triggers merely by attacking, because she has no vigilance.

restrictions.deck_level_constraint: max 5 rare/mythic cards total across mainboard+sideboard
